posts.theme: Iran flogs singer Parastoo Ahmadi 74 lashes for singing without hijab
posts.quote: 74 Lashes. Iran Flogged A Woman For Singing Without A Hijab.
posts.alt: Photo of Iranian singer Parastoo Ahmadi with long dark hair uncovered, wearing a black leather jacket and looking at the camera in a dimly lit room. Text reads: 74 Lashes. Iran Flogged A Woman For Singing Without A Hijab. Break The Spin logo top left. Photo credit: Hosseinronaghi, CC0 via Wikimedia Commons.
posts.caption:
She sang to an empty room. Iran answered with a whip.

Parastoo Ahmadi is 29. In December 2024 she stood in an old caravanserai near Qom with her hair uncovered, in a long sleeveless black dress, and sang with male musicians. No crowd. No tickets. Just a camera and her YouTube channel.

"I am Parastoo, a girl who wants to sing for the people I love," she wrote. "This is a right I could not ignore."

More than 3.2 million people watched. The regime saw a crime.

A court in Qom convicted her in June of "offending public decency." The sentence was 74 lashes, two years banned from making music, and two years banned from leaving the country. An appeals court upheld it in September.

On Nov. 23, the regime collected. Her lawyer says Ahmadi and four men from her team, three musicians and the concert organizer, each took 74 lashes at the prosecutor's office in Qom.

Her lawyers fought it to the end. "The other lawyers and I even tried to get the enforcement of the sentence postponed, but the enforcement branch insisted on carrying it out immediately," one told the BBC.

Women have been barred from singing solo in public in Iran since 1979.

Remember this the next time somebody tells you America is a dark place for women. Here, a woman can sing what she wants, wearing what she wants, and the worst she gets is a bad review. In Iran, singing to an empty room got her 74 lashes and a two-year gag order.

"She sang; the Islamic Republic responded with the lash," wrote Mahmood Amiry-Moghaddam of Iran Human Rights.

That is what a war on women actually looks like.
posts.first:
The facts: Parastoo Ahmadi, 29, performed without a hijab in a concert with no audience at the Deyr-e Gachin Caravanserai near Qom. It was posted to YouTube in December 2024. A Qom criminal court convicted her and eight others in June 2026 of "offending public decency" through online content and sentenced each to 74 lashes, a two-year ban on artistic activity, and a two-year travel ban. An appeals court in Qom upheld the ruling in September. Her lawyer, Mostafa Nili, said Ahmadi, musicians Soheil Faghih-Nasiri, Amin Taheri, and Amirali Pirnia, and organizer Mohsen Lashkari were flogged Nov. 23 in Qom. It is unclear whether the other four will be flogged. Iranian authorities did not respond to Reuters. Amnesty International had urged Iran to halt the sentences, calling flogging "a cruel, inhuman and degrading punishment."

Sources: BBC, Reuters via NBC News, AFP and Reuters via Al Jazeera, The Telegraph, Euronews, The National, Hengaw, Iran International, Amnesty International.
